text:
Mia Rivera: Hey team — first day quick help? Trying to embed a Grafana panel into Notion and I get a 403. Also Datadog dashboards show up but there is no "Share" option, and Sentry only shows sandbox projects for me. Who should I ask for access?
Sam Cho: welcome! For Grafana embeds you need the Okta group `grafana-viewers` plus the Grafana setting that allows panel embedding. Did you grab the panel > Share > Embed iframe link?
Mia Rivera: I tried the Share > Embed flow, copy/paste into Notion, it renders a blank box and a 403 in the iframe. Error: "You don't have permission to view this panel (403)". Panel URL (redacted): https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/panel?viewPanel=2
Lisa Patel: Mia — sounds like you don't have the Okta group. I can add you to grafana-viewers, but infra prefers tickets so it's auditable. Do you want me to add you directly for onboarding?
Mia Rivera: That'd be amazing if you can add me now. My company email is mia@redwood.com and Okta username is mia.rivera.
Sam Cho: For Datadog: if you can see dashboards but not Share, check your Datadog role. "Viewer" roles sometimes can't create share links — try asking for "Dashboard: Edit" or the datadog-monitors group. Also if you need alerts access, request "Monitors: Read".
Mia Rivera: Sentry — I only see a couple of sandbox projects. I need to peek at redwood-api-prod runbook. Is Sentry behind a group too?
Jordan Kim: Yep, prod Sentry projects are restricted. Add "sentry-prod-read" (or the sentry-devops group) on the ticket and list exact project slugs (e.g., redwood-api-prod, redwood-frontend-prod). We'll grant the least privilege needed.
Mia Rivera: What's the fastest way to create the ticket and what to include?
Lisa Patel: Use the infra access template — copy this into the access-requests queue.
Lisa Patel: ```
Title: Access request — Grafana / Datadog / Sentry
Requestor: Mia Rivera (mia@redwood.com)
Tools: Grafana (embed + viewer), Datadog (dashboard view/share), Sentry (redwood-api-prod)
Justification: onboarding — need dashboards for first-week runbooks, alerts, and SRE shadowing
Okta groups to add: grafana-viewers, datadog-monitors, sentry-prod-read
Slack handle: @mia
Urgency: 1 business day
```
Sam Cho: Pinging @devex and @infra-sso — can you help route this? Also FYI Notion sometimes strips auth cookies, try adding the iframe with `?kiosk=1` to avoid the top nav, or use a share link from Grafana with embed enabled.
devex-bot: Thanks Sam — created ticket INFRA-4521 for Mia Rivera (access-requests). Assigned to infra-sso. ETA: 1 business day.
Mia Rivera: Thanks! Any temporary workaround so I can view dashboards right now? VPN + incognito didn't help.
Lisa Patel: I can screenshare and walk through dashboards at 10:30 PDT if that works. Also the Datadog mobile app is often easier for quick alert checks. If you need screenshots for runbook editing I can export panels. :thumbsup:
Mia Rivera: 10:30 works, thank you both :heart:
